about: WildBrain Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops, produces, and distributes films and television programs in Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Franchise & Global Licensing, Content, and WildBrain Network. The company operates entertainment, sport, and brand licensing agencies under the Strawberry Shortcake, Teletubbies, Yo Gabba Gabba!, In the Night Garden, Inspector Gadget, and Degrassi brands; and personality AI. It also engages in the content production business, which includes series, specials and feature, digital, theatrical in animation for children and families; distribution of kids' and family content to streaming services, broadcasters, and on-demand services; and business licenses rights in new series, re-licenses existing library titles, as well as offers third-party produced titles and generates passive consumer products. In addition, the company owns and operates digital channels, including YouTube, AVOD, and FAST platforms; and sells direct advertising. The company was formerly known as DHX Media Ltd. and changed its name to WildBrain Ltd. in December 2019. WildBrain Ltd. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
